subject: science
concept: Understanding basic tools and methods humans use to study space (telescopes, satellites, space missions)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares what can be seen with the naked eye versus a simple telescope simulation
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a space-study tool to what it's used to observe or do
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a described tool is useful for studying space

misconception_flags: confuses the purpose of different space-study tools (e.g. satellite vs. telescope)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
